title: Close the Loop
tagline: Learn Rabt by playing — workflow, delegation, HITL

levels.title: Level 1 · Agentic workflow
levels.blurb: The case is a state machine. Only allowed edges work.

rounds.q: Case just ingested. Data quality passed. What is the next legal state?
rounds.why: New → Triaged after DQ. You cannot jump to Closed without evidence.

rounds.q: Triage says CRITICAL (very high BP). Next state?
rounds.why: CRITICAL goes to Escalated immediately — no LLM on this path.

rounds.q: Owner accepted. Patient got the card and passed teach-back. Next?
Someone tries Booked → Closed with no attendance. Result?
choices: Illegal — blocked by state machine / closure gate
rounds.why: False closures are blocked. Need Encounter + outcome, or human 4-eyes close.

levels.title: Level 2 · Agentic delegation
levels.blurb: The Coordinator is the supervisor. Agents propose; they don't freely rewrite state.

rounds.q: HbA1c value arrived. Who classifies urgency?
rounds.why: Triage is deterministic rules — LLM must not decide urgency.

rounds.q: Need an Arabic result card that never diagnoses. Who drafts it?
rounds.why: Comms is template-first; Foundry may rewrite reading level inside guardrails.

rounds.q: Patient asks “Do I have cancer?” after FIT+. Who answers?
rounds.why: Reassurance answers from approved KB with citations — never diagnoses.

rounds.q: Agent returns proposed_transition = Closed but evidence is empty. Coordinator should…
choices: Reject / raise to human — verifier fails
rounds.why: DelegationResult must pass verify (allowed edge + evidence) before transition.

levels.title: Level 3 · Human-in-the-loop
levels.blurb: Humans are safety gates. Timeouts never auto-close a case.

choices: Let LLM decide SMS text with values
Enqueue ladder, SMS without values, page coordinator
rounds.why: HITL critical path: no values on insecure channel, no LLM deciding.
Consent withdrawal is an immediate HITL pause.

rounds.q: Approval times out with no human vote. Safe default?

levels.title: Level 4 · Shipped safety & navigator
levels.blurb: Kill switch, honest AI labels, expert call, insurer preauth.

rounds.q: Keyword FAQ reassurance should timeline as…
rounds.why: No LLM ran — kind stays calculated (#70).

rounds.q: AI_ENABLED is false on Render. What happens on notify?
CRITICAL case, staff clicks Handle escalation with no call outcome…
choices: Rejected — must log call outcome first

rounds.q: Coverage says preauth pending. Patient taps Book…

boss.title: Boss round · Close Fatima’s loop
boss.win: Loop closed. No result left behind.
